definitions.explanation: Describing an attitude, project, or goal that pushes boundaries and embraces difficulty.
Describing behavior, a look, or an attitude that deliberately provokes or challenges someone.

examples.japanese: {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This project has very ambitious content.

examples.english: A provocative remark at the press conference stirred controversy.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧ (challenge) plus ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. The two senses reflect the dual nature of ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧ itself — it can mean undertaking a difficult challenge (positive) or confronting someone aggressively (negative).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: challenging goal
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: defiant attitude
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧: ambitious initiative
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: challenging stance
- {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}な⟦{目|め}つき→目つき：23141_metsuki⟧: provocative look

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意欲的|いよくてき}→意欲的：06262_iyokuteki⟧: ambitious; motivated — positive connotation only, without the provocative nuance
- ⟦{攻撃的|こうげきてき}→攻撃的：06243_kougekiteki⟧: aggressive; offensive — stronger hostility than the confrontational sense of {挑戦的|ちょうせんてき}
- {野心的|やしんてき}: ambitious — focuses on aspiration and grand scale rather than difficulty
